partners.title: Community & Employer Partners
partners.description: Partner with WorkforceAP: employers hire talent, referral orgs send candidates, workforce boards align, funders support scale. Clear next steps for each.
partners.heroCopy: Refer candidates, hire graduates, or align your workforce programs. Each partnership has a clear path and real outcomes.
partners.narrativeQuote: We partner with employers who hire, orgs who refer, workforce boards who align, and funders who scale. Each partnership type has a clear path — because building a skilled workforce takes all of us working together.
partners.narrativeCopy: Referral partners send us candidates who may benefit from career training offered at no cost to members. We reach out within 24–48 hours and walk them through the process. We welcome referrals of individuals motivated to improve the quality of their life and interested in training in technology, healthcare, manufacturing, or skilled trades.
partners.narrativeLi1: Submit a referral via our contact form or partner portal
partners.narrativeLi2: We contact the candidate within 24–48 hours
partners.narrativeLi3: Accepted members receive training, certificates, and job placement support
partners.narrativeLi4: You receive updates when referred individuals complete programs
partners.ctaCopy: Clear next steps, real outcomes, and a team that follows up within 1–2 business days.
partners.referralWho: Nonprofits, social services, churches, reentry programs, community centers, workforce centers, federal one-stop centers.
partners.referralWhy: Refer clients who need career training. We follow up within 1-2 business days. There is no cost to refer. You get updates when referred individuals complete programs.
partners.trainingWho: Educational institutions, community colleges, vocational schools, digital literacy centers.
partners.trainingWhy: Co-deliver employer-recognized certification programs. We bring the employer pipeline; you bring the learning environment.
partners.agencyWho: Workforce Solutions, TWC, WIOA providers, government workforce programs.
partners.agencyWhy: Align your participants with employer-recognized in-demand certifications. We handle training and placement; you strengthen outcomes for your population.
partners.funderWho: Foundations, corporate giving, impact investors, individual donors.
partners.funderWhy: Fund a model that works. Employer-aligned training, no participant debt, measurable job outcomes. We're growing nationwide and building toward national scale.
partners.platformFeature1Desc: Structured enrollment and eligibility screening reduces onboarding time by 60%, letting counselors focus on high-touch support.
partners.platformFeature2Desc: Partners access live data on referral status, enrollment progress, certification completions, and placement outcomes.
partners.platformFeature3Desc: Automated credential verification and WIOA-compliant reporting ensures accountability across every partnership.
partners.faq1a: Employers, workforce development boards, non-profit services, churches, community organizations, social service agencies, and educational institutions can partner with WorkforceAP to refer candidates or hire graduates.
partners.faq2q: Is there a cost to refer candidates?
partners.faq2a: No. There is no cost to refer someone. We welcome partners who want to connect individuals in their network with our career training programs that are offered at no cost to members.
partners.faq3a: Contact us at info@workforceap.org or (512) 777-1808 with the candidate's name and contact information. You can also use our contact form and select "Partnership" as the topic.
partners.faq4a: Yes. We actively connect employers with job-ready graduates. Reach out to discuss your hiring needs and we can share candidate profiles and schedule introductions.
partners.faq5a: Partners receive regular updates on referral status, program completion rates, and placement outcomes. Our digital platform provides real-time dashboards for tracking progress.

employers.title: Hire Certified Tech Graduates
employers.description: Access pre-screened, certified tech talent. WorkforceAP graduates hold industry credentials from Google, IBM, AWS, CompTIA. Post jobs or become a hiring partner. Serving employers nationwide.
employers.waitlistCopy: We're focused on placing our first cohort right now. Hire-now applications are welcome below — we'll match you with certified candidates as they finish their programs. Hiring volume scales over the next two cohorts.
employers.heroCopy: Start the employer intake with your hiring use case, role needs, volume, and timeline. We will route you to the right partnership path and follow up with matched talent options.
employers.valueCard1Desc: Members complete training and are vetted through the Workforce Advancement Project process — with industry credentials from Google, IBM, Microsoft, AWS, CompTIA.
employers.valueCard2Desc: Access talent from underserved communities, adult learners, and veterans — bringing fresh perspectives and resilience to your teams.
employers.valueCard3Desc: 150-day onboarding support for every hire. We help your new team members succeed long-term, not just on day one.
employers.valueCard4Desc: Customized training pathways designed in partnership with employers to ensure curriculum aligns with specific organizational needs.
employers.processStep1Desc: Add your job to our employer portal. We match it to our pipeline.
employers.processStep2Desc: Receive pre-screened applicants who hold relevant certifications.
employers.processStep3Desc: You conduct interviews and make the hire on your timeline.
employers.processStep4Desc: We support your new hire's onboarding for long-term success.
employers.tierStandardF2: Access to active members and alumni
employers.statTracks: Career tracks aligned to employer demand
employers.formSubtitle: Tell us about your hiring needs and we will follow up within 1–2 business days.
employers.ctaCopy: Join a growing network of employers hiring WorkforceAP graduates. Industry-certified, pre-screened, and supported through onboarding.

impact.intro: Workforce Advancement Project helps people move into stronger career paths through no-cost training, employer-informed program design, and wraparound support that keeps momentum moving after enrollment.
impact.stat1Label: Years removing barriers to workforce opportunity
impact.stat2Label: Learners trained through workforce development programs (historical)
impact.stat3Label: Career tracks aligned to real employer demand
impact.stat4Label: Cost to members — funded by grants and partnerships
impact.modelDesc: Employer partnerships and public funding help cover program access, support services, and workforce readiness so members can focus on learning and placement.
impact.membersDesc: Career-aligned training, recognized certificates, structured guidance, and support with applications, resumes, and employer introductions when timing is right.
impact.whyDesc: The goal is not just course completion. It is durable movement toward employment, higher earnings, and clearer next steps for the people and communities WorkforceAP serves.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.description: Read Workforce Advancement Project accessibility commitments and how to request help using the site.
accessibility.heading: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.intro: Workforce Advancement Project works to make this site easier to use for members, partners, employers, and community supporters. We aim to provide clear content, readable layouts, keyboard-usable navigation, and mobile-friendly access on slow devices and limited connections.
accessibility.helpTitle: If you need help using this site
accessibility.helpCopy: If you run into a barrier while using WorkforceAP.org, contact us and we will do our best to provide the information or support you need in another format.
accessibility.improvementsCopy1: We continue improving content clarity, color contrast, tap targets, and responsive behavior across public and member-facing pages.
accessibility.improvementsCopy2: If something is hard to read, navigate, or complete, please tell us. That feedback helps us improve access for the people this work is meant to serve.
